clears bit 0 of the flag byte (+3) of club records 0-10; called when day_events_build_week queues the year-96 girl 10 meeting or the year-97 career guidance on a marker-2 day

called twice by MASTER: finds the (weekday+1)-th end-of-day record (0xFB), points day_event_index at that day (backing up over the day's non-0x25 records), then turns every later 0x25 record into type 0, so the girl byte (0 or 7) becomes the command of an ordinary school day; type is 0xFF-terminated

1 on 1998-02-15 when at least 2 of girls 0-10 are met with 501+ points (girl_scores), girl 11 story stage >= 4, event_flags 76 and 78 set, appointment 0 not active and (rand & 0xF) < 5; day_events_build_week then queues special event girl 11 scene 4 on that holiday

(out girl, out scene) 1 in 3 chance per call (rand % 3 == 0), then the first girl not yet met whose command (last_command nibble) and parameter threshold match: girl 1 liberal arts >= 0x37 command 0, girl 2 science >= 0x3C command 1, girl 3 art >= 0x32 command 2, girl 5 athletics and looks >= 0x51 command 3 (not if girl 0's club is 8), girl 6 athletics and guts >= 0x1F command 3 (not if girl 0's club is 9), girl 7 looks >= 0x65 command 6, girl 8 trivia 0x24/0x38/0x4C/0x5B by her story stage 0-3 (stage 3 needs command 5), girl 4 guts >= 0x24 when her club differs from the player's; used while fewer than 2 of girls 1-9 are met; emu: from the title-menu state with mode 0x30, date 1995-05-07, command 0 and liberal arts 0x40 the built week holds a 0x48 record for girl 1 scene 0

same selector as meeting_select_catchup with a 1 in 8 chance (rand & 7 == 0) and higher thresholds: liberal arts 0x4B, science 0x55, art 0x41, athletics and looks 0x54, athletics and guts 0x47, looks 0x7E, guts 0x60 (girl 4), girl 8 unchanged; used when at least 2 of girls 1-9 are met

(out girl, out scene) 1 in 3 chance, then for the player's club: the first unmet girl of girls 1-6 whose club equals the player's club and (girls 1-5) club exp >= 0x15; sets her flag bit 18 and returns a scene by club (girl 1 scene 2 + (frame&1) in club 0 else 4, girl 2 scene 4 in club 2 else 5, girl 3 scene 1 in club 4 else 2, girl 4 scene 1 in club 6 else 2, girl 5 scene 1 in club 8, girl 6 scene 1 in club 9); the last two skip when girl 0 is in that club

(command) girl shown with the week's command: for the command's girl(s) (command 0 girl 1, 1 girl 2, 2 girl 3, 3 girls 5 and 6, 4 the same-club girl, 5 girl 8, 6 girl 7, 7 none) compares girl_scores rank minus a bar (command_rank_bar_*) with girl 0's rank minus the same bar; returns the girl when she beats the bar and girl 0, else 0 when girl 0 beats the bar, else 0xF; the result goes in DayEvent.extra of the school-day records and in the 0x47 girl choice

mode 0x39 handler (queue type 0xFD): stage 0 = vacation_notice_step, stage 1 = day_event_index += 1 and back to mode 0x31; redraws the HUD pieces whose hidden bit (0x80) is set

mode 0x39 stage 0: step 0 shows a one-line notice and updates vacation (a running break ends; otherwise month 7 starts summer, 12 winter, 3 spring; else 0) then reloads the season sound set with func_800674B0; step 1 waits for the sound bank (snd_bank_load_poll), restarts sequence 0 and goes to the next stage; other steps call game_reset_to_title; emu: mode 0x39 poked in month 7 gives vacation 1, month 12 gives 2, month 3 gives 3, month 8 with vacation 1 gives 0, months 5 and 9 give 0
mode 0x38 handler (queue type 0xFE): stage 0 = month_start_step_dispatch, stage 1 = day_event_index += 1 and back to mode 0x31; then the HUD draw set
mode 0x38 stage 0 step switch: step 0 = month_data_load_step, step 1 = month_start_music_wait

mode 0x38 stage 0 step 0: substep 0 reads 0x95 sectors from LBA 0x9B94 to 0x801A0000; substep 1 once read: func_80068938(year, month, 1) loads the next month's calendar; in months 3, 6, 9, 12 it plays sound 0xC1, reloads the season set (func_800674B0), calls amusement_park_flag_reset and sets D_800B5BC8 = 0xEF (September also shows a new-term notice, except on 1996-09-01 where it only goes on); other months go straight to the next stage
mode 0x38 stage 0 step 1: when the sound bank load is done (snd_bank_load_poll == 1) restart sequence 0 and main_stage_next
mode 0x32 handler (queue type 0xFC): stage 0 = week_end_hud_init, stage 1 = health_step_dispatch, stage 0xFF or other = func_800737A0 (the weekday handler); then the HUD draw set
mode 0x32 stage 0: parameter_show_init, hizuke_init, message_window_init, main_stage_next

mode 0x32 stage 1: step_timer += 1, then by step: 0 health_check_roll, 1 health_injury_start, 2 health_neurosis_start, 3 health_illness_start, 5 health_injury_recover, 6 health_neurosis_recover, 7 health_illness_recover; any other step leaves to stage 0xFF

weekly health decision, by health state (player_flags bits 8-11): healthy and recovery_days == 0: injury step when condition < 20 and 204 + guts/8 (max 254) < (rand & 0xFF), or condition == 0; neurosis step when stress >= 0x51 and the same limit < (seed & 0xFF); both = illness step. Injured: illness when the stress test hits, recovery when condition >= 31. Neurotic: illness when the condition test hits or condition == 0, recovery when stress < 0x46. Sick: recovery when stress < 0x46 and condition >= 31, else on a school day a girl may visit (mode 0x62); nothing queued = stage 0xFF; emu: mode 0x32 stage 1 with condition 0 goes to step 1 and the health nibble becomes 1

mode 0x32 step 1: substep 0 shows the injury message and sets health 1; substep 1 waits 61 frames, then 257 frames or a newly pressed button; substep 2: 25/256 chance (frame_count & 0xFF < 0x19) with event_flags 75 clear and vacation 0 starts special event girl 11 scene 2 (mode 0x5D) and sets event_flags 75, else stage 0xFF
mode 0x32 step 2: shows the neurosis message, health 2, waits 61 frames then 257 frames or a held button (pad_held, not pad_pressed), stage 0xFF
mode 0x32 step 3: starts sequence 0x202, shows the illness message, health 3 (halves parameter gains), same wait as neurosis, stage 0xFF
mode 0x32 step 5: sets the 3-bit recovery_days counter to 3, clears the health state, shows the injury-healed message, same wait, stage 0xFF
mode 0x32 step 6: same as health_injury_recover with the neurosis-healed message
mode 0x32 step 7: same as health_injury_recover with the illness-healed message
